en.incomeText: The basics here — creating, valuing, and sharing cards — are available without registration. If you wish to earn "EW/ART" reward points, or generate passive income through daily tasks on earnway.art, you must register on the platform; identity verification (KYC) is required for withdrawals. This integration is an optional value-add and does not interfere with the core experience.
